name: case-anything
description: camelCase, kebab-case, PascalCase... a simple integration with nano package size. (SMALL footprint!)

scripts.release: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm test && bumpp --no-push --all && pnpm publish --no-git-checks && pnpm dlx jsr publish ${JSR_TOKEN:+--token $JSR_TOKEN} && git push --follow-tags && gh release create $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0) --generate-notes --notes "$(git log --pretty='- %s  %h' $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD~1 2>/dev/null || git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)..HEAD~1)"

author: Luca Ban - Mesqueeb (https://cycraft.co)
